column7: Scrubs a listener note of the backend's injected values, or withholds it when the set has overflowed; a mistake hands an echoed secret to a subscriber.
Names a backend body that did not parse by category and position only; serde's own text quotes the rejected bytes, escaped past the literal scrub, so a mistake leaks an injected value into an error.
Installs the backend's value set the HTTP transport scrubs with; a missed attach leaves every answer unscrubbed (the send path then refuses the call).
Scrubs a notification on an answer's SSE stream, or withholds it; a mistake publishes an echoed secret to the caller.
Declares that this transport scrubs what it reads; the send path refuses a call carrying an injected value to a transport that does not, so a wrong answer either leaks or refuses every secret call.
Installs the backend's value set the stdio transport scrubs with; a missed attach leaves every line unscrubbed (the send path then refuses the call).
Declares that this transport scrubs what it reads; the send path's fail-closed refusal reads it, so a wrong answer either leaks or refuses every secret call.
Logs a stdio line the transport could not handle by its error kind only, keeping text solely for the gateway's own refusal; a mistake writes a backend line, an echoed secret among it, to the log.
